svg.title: MLB wallets: result while picked vs the next month
svg.desc: 3016 wallet-months with at least 10 copies in both periods; 2983 inside the +-$6 window shown. Spearman by month: -0.01, +0.15, +0.08, -0.03.
svg.text: MLB: a good two months says little about the next one
Each dot is a wallet in one test month (at least 10 copies in both periods). Rank correlation by month:
-0.01, +0.15, +0.08, -0.03. Copies at their price + 1 cent; window clipped at +-$6 (2983 of 3016 dots shown).
While picked: $ per $10 copied over the previous two months
